gloss: muscular and powerfully built; having a strong, well-developed physique

definitions.gloss: muscular and powerfully built; having a strong, well-developed physique
definitions.explanation: muscular and powerfully built; having a strong, well-developed physique

examples.japanese: {筋骨|きんこつ}たくましい⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧だ。
{筋骨|きんこつ}たくましい⟦{体|からだ}つき→体つき：17058_karadatsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{力士|りきし}→力士：10115_rikishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{土俵|どひょう}→土俵：12010_dohyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: A powerfully built sumo wrestler stepped onto the ring.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{肉体|にくたい}{労働|ろうどう}→肉体労働：22825_nikutairoudou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{筋骨|きんこつ}たくましい⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧になった。
examples.english: From daily physical labor, he developed a muscular physique.

notes:
A set phrase combining {筋骨|きんこつ} (muscles and bones; physical frame) with ⟦たくましい→たくましい：06255_takumashii⟧ (sturdy/robust). Describes someone with a visibly strong, well-muscled body — the kind of physique associated with physical laborers, athletes, or warriors.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {筋骨|きんこつ}たくましい⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧ — a powerfully built body
- {筋骨|きんこつ}たくましい⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧ — a muscular man
- {筋骨|きんこつ}たくましい⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧ — brawny arms

USAGE:
Typically describes men, though not exclusively. The expression has a somewhat literary or descriptive quality — it appears more in written descriptions (novels, journalism, character descriptions) than in casual conversation, where マッチョ (macho) or ⟦{筋肉質|きんにくしつ}→筋肉質：16302_kinnikushitsu⟧ (muscular) might be preferred.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦がっしり→がっしり：19940_gasshiri⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧ — solidly built; sturdy (more casual)
- マッチョ — macho; muscular (loanword, casual)
- ⟦{筋肉質|きんにくしつ}→筋肉質：16302_kinnikushitsu⟧ — muscular (objective description of body type)
- ⟦たくましい→たくましい：06255_takumashii⟧ — sturdy; robust (the adjective alone, broader meaning)
